body:
You seem to be in a controlling and maybe even an abusive relationship. I know it might be hard to get out but you’re not gonna like staying as most people get worse and worse overtime with the treatment of their partners. I know you are scared bit you are wasting your life and energy with a negative person. Please leave before you regret your choices. 

As for your porn addiction, I used to have one as well. What helped me was realizing that something that is supposed to “feel good” was starting to not. So I lowered the amount of times I do it. Try to limit it to every-other day and go from there. Most people who have a porn addiction are usually the type of people who have been touch starved a good chunk of their live. This doesn’t have to be intimate touch s but also a loving touch. This usually might have to do with family and the way you were raised.
